sideB.text:
We now need to complete 3 objectives each month.

Use the objective calendar on the board to help you remember how many objectives you need to complete each month.

Calendar illustration, left edge cropped. Visible header: "IE FALL – OBJECTIVES AND". FEBRUARY: two stars, 33. MARCH: three stars, 30 (column outlined). APRIL: three stars, 27. The next column is cut off and shows one star.

mechanics.whenRead: Continue the March setup Legacy-deck reading. Side A says KEEP DRAWING, so read side B and draw the next card.
rules: From March on, the group must complete 3 objectives each month.
The pictured calendar is the board's objective-and-supply calendar: February still shows 2 objective stars and 33 supply cubes; March and April show 3 stars, with 30 and 27 supply cubes.
mechanics.notes: "3 objectives" is bold. The calendar header is clipped on the left, so only "IE FALL – OBJECTIVES AND" is visible. The dash in that header is an en dash.
